pages.text: Frequently asked questions about the Sokoni Savings Bond, published by the SYN Central Bank. Question: What is the minimum purchase of the Sokoni Savings Bond? Answer: SYN Sh 3,000. Question: Is interest on the Sokoni Savings Bond taxed? Answer: No, the interest is tax-exempt. These answers are updated whenever the rules change.
